headline: Children aged 11-16 to get free bus travel in Greater Manchester
meta_description: Young people in Greater Manchester will receive free bus travel under a new scheme benefiting children aged 11-16.
summary_short: Greater Manchester is introducing free bus travel for children aged 11-16, opening up new opportunities for young people across the region.
body:
Greater Manchester is rolling out free bus travel for children aged 11-16, a move that promises to transform how young people move around the region.

The scheme removes a significant financial barrier for families, allowing children across the age range to travel without cost. This opens doors for young people to reach schools, leisure activities, and community spaces more easily, regardless of their family's circumstances.

The initiative reflects growing recognition that affordable transport is essential infrastructure for young people's independence and access to opportunity.
quick_facts: Free bus travel across the region
Removes transport costs for young people
